name: Incident Response
description: First-pass triage runbook: snapshot system, capture recent changes, scrape error patterns from logs, then call into the agent-memory recall to suggest a starting hypothesis. Designed to run from a Telegram-bound or web-pinned alert.

steps.description: Compact host snapshot — uptime, load, memory, disk
Anything modified in /etc within the last 24h, plus the last few package operations
Last hour of journal errors + a coarse keyword scan across /var/log
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${inputs.host} 'journalctl --since "1 hour ago" -p err -n 200 --no-pager; grep -RinE "error|critical|fail|panic" /var/log --include=*.log 2>/dev/null | tail -50'

steps.description: Ask the agent-memory store for similar prior resolutions
One-screen rollup the operator pastes into the incident channel
steps.command: echo 'Triage on ${inputs.host}: snapshot=${steps.system_snapshot.ok}, recent_changes=${steps.recent_changes.ok}, error_scan=${steps.error_scan.ok}, pattern_recall=${steps.pattern_recall.ok}. Title: ${inputs.incidentTitle} sev=${inputs.severity}.'
